name: J.A.R.V.I.S. HUD
author: zhou-jianwen
variant_note: An independently AI-generated V2 interpretation of the J.A.R.V.I.S. interface requested in #291: a compact realistic 3D cyan instrument with concentric rings and an attached gimballed scanner, without a human likeness.
description: An unofficial J.A.R.V.I.S.-inspired cyan instrument companion with concentric ring housing and an attached gimballed scanning aperture. The Iron Man identity follows request #291; this mechanical HUD interpretation contains no human likeness. zhou-jianwen is the independent AI-assisted adapter.
source_notes: The requester-supplied cyan HUD image (https://api.codexpet.top/uploads/reference/references/b2963a5d3fdd6128ce2933a4dd2dc2c3c0e5d7f4238347ff9a07a32dcab50b14.png) was used only as an appearance reference. Its artist, official authenticity, and redistribution permission are unverified. The submitter's production decision is an independently AI-generated, non-commercial, reference-only instrument interpretation; no reference pixels are committed, and no maintainer acceptance or underlying rights are asserted. All poses were generated with native alpha using the built-in image_gen tool, followed by native-alpha extraction and deterministic shared-scale assembly. After an independent reviewer identified a hard reset in the standard right-locomotion loop, its eight existing poses were reordered using zero-based source indices 0, 2, 4, 6, 7, 5, 3, 1; that ordering repair introduced no new drawing, resampling, or pixel changes to those poses.
